diagnosis: The notification hub WebSocket server inspects the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header for user.client.<userId> and registers the connection for real-time notification streams without authenticating the user. Any user can connect declaring another user's ID in the subprotocol header to receive private personal notifications, login verification codes, and security alerts.
